I will do this plot much like last season, only I will put a little fertilizer if I get the money in time, because this land is mine and I do not want to leave it hungry. I intercrop my roots, I keep planting material from what I know, and I also carry manure from home when I can because that one does not take cash like the shop fertilizer. I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains, and I will use mostly my family hands, then pay a few men only when the work is too heavy.
